photos.title: Atlantic Ocean shoreline in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
photos.what: A row of oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach, from the beach, with the tops of beach umbrellas in front. No person is recognizable.
photos.caption: Oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach.
photos.alt: A row of high-rise towers with balconies along the beach in Myrtle Beach, with beach umbrellas in front
photos.author: Loadmaster (David R. Tribble)

photos.provenance: Licence and author confirmed on the file page by the batch 2026-11-e verifier (VERIFY.md, photos table: CC BY-SA 3.0, Loadmaster (David R. Tribble), 30 June 2014, 2592 x 1728). Downloaded as Commons' 1920 px rendition on 2026-11-04. The same source photo as /invest/short-term-rental-rules-statehouse/, cropped differently.
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer on 2026-11-04. The crop (x 0 to 1000, y 85 to 585 of the 1920 x 1280 rendition) keeps the towers and the umbrella tops and leaves out the people on the beach; one head at the bottom edge is a few pixels and not recognizable. The towers are not named and the caption does not say whether each is a hotel or condos: every unit an owner rents out, in either, is taxed at 6% (S.C. Const. Art. X, Sec. 1(5)).
